evidence.text: Nuufolau Joel `` Joe '' Seanoa -LRB- born March 17 , 1979 -RRB- , better known by his ring name Samoa Joe , is an American professional wrestler currently signed to WWE and performing on the Raw brand .
Joe established himself in ROH from the promotion 's beginning in 2002 , holding the ROH World Championship for a record 21 months from May 2003 to December 2004 .
Joe officially debuted in WWE 's developmental territory NXT in May 2015 , and signed a full-time contract with the company in June ; he went on to become the first ever two-time NXT Champion .

Samoa is a member of the Commonwealth of Nations .
